title: Grounding the students of the logged actions: probe and selection over five seeds
description: Step 5 of the plan (docs/methodology.md). The students of release exp-student-confirm-17 (experiments/codec.py with targets=action; 3, 4, 6 and 8 latents, seeds 0 to 4) are grounded as the codecs were in release exp-ground-knee-13: experiments/ground.py probe (what of each base variable the latents hold, what of the latents the base variables hold, and whether seeds agree on the latent space) and select (the path of library features that best spans the latents, per run and pooled over the runs of a width, with its vocabulary sensitivity check). Fits on training links, scores on validation links; the test links are not read. The selection here is scored on the fit of the latents; scoring it on the action is a later run of experiments/actions.py that reads this release. Steps and labels: release exp-steps-broad-30s-9.
collect: test -s "$OUT/probe/summary.md" && test -s "$OUT/select/summary.md" && { echo '# Probe'; echo; cat "$OUT/probe/summary.md"; echo; echo '# Selection'; echo; cat "$OUT/select/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
